# What a diff of two deep scans of one item infers (ForeverMarket scan/Diff.lua FM.DiffFingerprints).
# Shared by tests/forevermarket/diff_test.lua and tests/feed/test_feed.py (the feed's Python port):
# both must reach exactly these results.
#
# case <name>                          starts a case
# gap <minutes>                        time between the two scans
# prev <owner> <count> <buyout> <band> an auction of the previous scan
# cur <owner> <count> <buyout> <band>  an auction of the scan now
#   owner: "?" = seller unknown (Forever's full scan, the Battle.net API), any other word = one seller
#   buyout: total copper of the auction; band: time left 0 short, 1 medium, 2 long, 3 very long
#   a band guarantees at least 0 / 30 min / 2 h / 8 h left
# expect <name>=<value> ...            all eight results; newMin=none when nothing new was listed
#   sold     units bought          soldN   auctions bought     soldVal  copper paid
#   amb      units gone that may have expired (sold or expired)
#   rep      units reposted (cancelled and listed again)
#   new      units newly listed    newMin  cheapest new unit price
#   soldLow  units bought that were the cheapest (a cheaper auction that stayed = more likely cancelled)

case partial-buy
# a commodity stack got smaller at the same unit price: the difference was bought
gap 60
prev ? 20 2000 3
cur ? 15 1500 3
expect sold=5 soldN=1 soldVal=500 amb=0 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=5

case cheapest-gone-is-sold
# a very long auction cannot expire within an hour: gone = bought, and it was the cheapest
gap 60
prev ? 5 500 3
prev ? 5 600 3
cur ? 5 600 3
expect sold=5 soldN=1 soldVal=500 amb=0 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=5

case gone-while-cheaper-stayed
# bought (or cancelled) while a cheaper auction stayed: sold, but not counted as a cheapest buy
gap 60
prev ? 5 500 3
prev ? 5 600 3
cur ? 5 500 3
expect sold=5 soldN=1 soldVal=600 amb=0 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=0

case short-band-gone-is-ambiguous
# a short auction can run out any time: gone = sold or expired
gap 10
prev ? 3 300 0
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=3 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=0

case long-band-gone-after-its-minimum
# 9 hours later even a very long auction (at least 8 h left) may have expired
gap 540
prev ? 2 400 3
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=2 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=0

case known-seller-reposts
# the same seller lists the item again: a repost, and the new auction counts as newly listed
gap 60
prev ab12 10 1000 3
cur ab12 10 900 3
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=0 rep=10 new=10 newMin=90 soldLow=0

case other-seller-lists-new
# another seller's new auction does not make the first one a repost
gap 60
prev ab12 10 1000 3
cur cd34 10 900 3
expect sold=10 soldN=1 soldVal=1000 amb=0 rep=0 new=10 newMin=90 soldLow=10

case unknown-seller-undercut-repost
# seller unknown: the same quantity listed again at 70-130% of the old unit price is most likely a repost
gap 60
prev ? 10 1000 3
cur ? 10 850 3
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=0 rep=10 new=10 newMin=85 soldLow=0

case unknown-seller-far-cheaper-is-no-repost
# at 50% of the old unit price it is a new auction, and the old one was bought
gap 60
prev ? 10 1000 3
cur ? 10 500 3
expect sold=10 soldN=1 soldVal=1000 amb=0 rep=0 new=10 newMin=50 soldLow=10

case band-drop-is-no-change
# only the time left went down: the same auction, nothing happened
gap 60
prev ? 2 200 3
cur ? 2 200 2
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=0 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=0

case oldest-identical-auction-goes-first
# of two identical auctions the one with less time left (the older) is the one that went:
# a medium auction may have expired after an hour
gap 60
prev ? 1 100 3
prev ? 1 100 1
cur ? 1 100 3
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=1 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=0

case watched-sales
# a partial buy, a whole auction bought above the cheapest, and a new cheaper listing
# (diff_test.lua also checks the watched item details: every sale and the new listings ladder)
gap 60
prev ? 5 500 3
prev ? 5 600 3
prev ? 4 520 3
cur ? 5 500 3
cur ? 2 260 3
cur ? 3 270 3
expect sold=7 soldN=2 soldVal=860 amb=0 rep=0 new=3 newMin=90 soldLow=2

case own-mark-lost-is-no-change
# FRV-72: your mark ("@", a best fit of your auctions and posts) left an auction that stayed, e.g. your posts left
# the pool after 24h: "@" and "?" are one seller class, the same auction, nothing happened
gap 60
prev @ 10 1000 3
cur ? 10 1000 3
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=0 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=0

case own-mark-gained-is-no-change
# FRV-72: the best fit marked an auction that was unknown before: the same auction
gap 60
prev ? 10 1000 3
cur @ 10 1000 3
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=0 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=0

case own-mark-moves-to-a-twin
# FRV-72: of two auctions of the same quantity and price the mark moved from one to the other: nothing happened
gap 60
prev @ 5 500 3
prev ? 5 500 2
cur ? 5 500 3
cur @ 5 500 2
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=0 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=0

case own-auction-gone-its-twin-stays
# FRV-72: one of two auctions of the same quantity and price went and your mark with it: yours was bought
# (the twin stays at that price, so it was the cheapest)
gap 60
prev @ 5 500 3
prev ? 5 500 3
cur ? 5 500 3
expect sold=5 soldN=1 soldVal=500 amb=0 rep=0 new=0 newMin=none soldLow=5

case own-repost-stays-a-repost
# you undercut yourself: your auction went and a new one of yours came, a repost as before FRV-72
gap 60
prev @ 10 1000 3
cur @ 8 720 3
expect sold=0 soldN=0 soldVal=0 amb=0 rep=10 new=8 newMin=90 soldLow=0
